        structure LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.ThinPathCoefficientData {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : Type v} [Quiver Q] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{max (max u v) w, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (D : CategoryTheory.Functor FreeLinearCategory C) [D.Additive] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear k D] :
        Type (max (max u v) w)

        Scalar coefficient data for a linear functor out of a thin free path category. The last field is the scalar form of the two-variable naturality required by BGRS Proposition 3.2. In a radical-square-zero quiver its paths are only identities and arrows, so this is precisely the finite family of stable-supplement inclusions used in BGRS 3.4 and 3.7.

        • path_subsingleton (a b : Q) : Subsingleton (Quiver.Path a b)

          The path-coefficient projection. Thinness makes a nonempty path set a singleton, so one scalar reconstructs the entire source Hom element.
